name: Build your first agent
description: Your first AI agent in ByteChef. The agent uses an OpenAI model and one tool, the HTTP Client, to fetch a random quote from a public API, then explains the quote in one sentence and logs the answer. It runs on a manual trigger, so after importing it you connect your OpenAI API key, click Run and watch the tool call in the execution log.
shortDescription: An OpenAI agent that calls one tool to fetch a quote and explains it, in one click.
keyFeatures: AI Agent component with an OpenAI model
One tool, the HTTP Client, that the agent decides to call
System prompt that tells the agent when to use the tool
Logger step that shows the agent's answer in the execution log
prerequisites: Internet access to reach the public quotes API
idealFor: Anyone who has run their first workflow and wants to see an agent pick and call a tool, with a single connection to set up.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Explain a quote: the AI Agent calls the Get a random quote tool, an HTTP GET on dummyjson.com/quotes/random, and writes a one-sentence explanation.
Log the answer: the Logger step prints the agent's reply to the execution log.
